correctness.rationale: For each n>=2 and q=p^f, the bracket recursion yields a unique triangular automorphism normal form with a nonzero leading scalar and principal-unit coordinate. Product law (a,U)(b,V)=(ab,U(t)V(at)) is checked by composition. For scalar a of order d coprime to p, N_d is surjective onto fixed units W_d by d-th roots in the finite p-group; its kernel equals im(1-tau_a) by exact size and telescoping, with trivial fixed intersection. Burnside gives conjugacy classes and Frobenius p-power filtration gives exact order counts, including r=0, d=1, n=2 and q=2. A standalone arithmetic checker exhaustively enumerated actual group multiplication, commuting pairs and element orders for eleven (q,n) cases over F2,F3,F4,F5; it returned CYCLIC_LEIBNIZ_CENSUS_OK. The infinite-range theorem is proved symbolically, not inferred from those finite runs.

value.rationale: The conjugacy-class count and full element-order distribution are intrinsic, natural and complementary invariants of the finite symmetry groups of a classical infinite family of cyclic nilpotent Leibniz algebras. The formulas resolve all finite fields including characteristic two and all dimensions, giving group class number, number of commuting pairs, and exact order stratification. They are not an arbitrary parameter slice or a single small numerical improvement, and the proof isolates a reusable coprime norm decomposition of truncated principal units. Scientific interest does not depend on a separate downstream theorem; the count is a complete arithmetic description of the specific invariants.
